self.title: Cycle 131 · Refining Path-Dependent Divergence Experiment and Hypothesis

detail.title: Refining Path-Dependent Divergence Experiment and Hypothesis
detail.summary: This cycle refines the hypothesis and experiment for proj-divergent-values-01 to address previous measurement invalidity by stabilizing the Python simulation code and properly structuring the numerical observation protocol. We also provide the required continuity probe response.
